Railway RRB JE Online Form 2026 (4029 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released a notification for the RRB CEN 04/2026 recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS posts on its official website. The online application process for RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 has started from 14 August 2026 & the candidates can apply until 13 September 2026. Total of 4029 vacancies have been announced for Junior Engineer posts under RRB Junior Engineer JE CEN 04/2026 Recruitment. Candidates must check the Complete details for RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 14 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply : 13 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 15 September 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 16-25 September 2026
  • Application Status : Notify Soon
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Exam City Details : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
